items.summary: ## NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B [Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B](https://ollama.com/library/nemotron-3.5-bolt) is NVIDIA’s smaller, Gemma 4-based vision-language model for fast local conversations, image understanding, and tool use. It supports a 128K-token context window. The model includes a DFlash draft for speculative decoding. ollama run nemotron-3.5-bolt:e4b **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.9...v0.40.10
